articles.summary: Raises Adjusted EBITDA and Gross Margin Outlook for Full Year 2026 R eiterates Revenue Guidance as Project Gravity Delivers on Plan Traeger, Inc. ("Traeger" or the "Company") (NYSE: COOK), creator and category leader of the wood pellet grill, today announced its financial results for the three months ended March 31, 2026. First Quarter 2026 Results Total revenues decreased 34.3% to $94.1 million Grill revenues decreased 45.4% to $47.4 million Net income of $2.9 million or $1.08 per diluted share
articles.title: Traeger Announces First Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results
